exact_statement: For every p in (0,1), every finite product-biased cube, every coordinate i of bias p and every real f whose two restrictions f_0,f_1 have unit L2 norm (in particular every Boolean f): J_i - M_i = h2(p) - sum_T q_T F(t_T) <= tau*(p) := h2(p) - min_t F(t) <= (1/2)[h2(p) + log2 max(p,1-p)], where F(t) = h2(sin^2 t) + h2(sin^2(t-b)), sin^2 b = min(p,1-p), (sqrt(1-p)G_T, sqrt(p)H_T) = sqrt(q_T)(cos t_T, sin t_T). The last inequality is strict for p != 1/2, and tau*(p) = (p/2)log2(1/p) - 0.2787p + o(p), so the constant 1/2 is sharp as p -> 0.
hypotheses: selector coordinate independent with bias p in (0,1)
